# 💡 Feature Request

Thanks for suggesting an improvement to the MCST3RX Football Save Editor.

Please provide as much information as possible so the request can be properly reviewed.

## Editor Version

What version of the editor are you using?

Example: `v1.2.1`

## Game

Which game does this request apply to?

- [ ] Madden NFL
- [ ] College Football 27
- [ ] General editor / not game-specific

## Game Version / Mode

Please provide the specific game/version and mode when applicable.

Examples:

`Madden NFL 27 — Franchise`

`College Football 27 — Dynasty`

`College Football 27 — Road to Glory`

## Feature or Improvement

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

## Why Would This Be Useful?

Explain what problem this would solve or how it would improve the editor.

## How Should It Work?

Describe how you imagine the feature working.

Include where it might appear in the editor and what you expect it to do.

## Area of the Editor

- [ ] Player Editing
- [ ] Career / Franchise
- [ ] Dynasty
- [ ] Road to Glory
- [ ] Save Management
- [ ] Backups / Recovery
- [ ] User Interface
- [ ] Installer / Packaging
- [ ] Other

## Examples or References

Add screenshots, mockups, examples, or references if they help explain the request.

## Additional Information

Add anything else that may help explain the request.

---

Please submit **one feature request per issue** so each idea can be reviewed and tracked separately.

Feature requests are suggestions and are not guaranteed to be implemented.
